admission_claim.verdict: the fee is 85.9% of the admission round trip

cross_population_defect.correct_statement: the fee is 85.9% of the admission round trip (20 bps of 23.2778 bps); the 1.3863 ratio mixes four venue schedules with one admission scenario and must not be read as a cost share
cross_population_defect.explanation: the published 1.3863 divides a cross-venue mean fee by an admission-only mean barrier; the fee was not double counted and no identity was broken in the gate, the identity was broken by the sentence at render time

numerator.why_it_is_a_real_number: each of the four schedules has its own taker fee; their mean is the cost of a product a trader would choose between, not the cost of one product
